title: Volvo FM FH Custom Built FUPS Compliant Polished Aluminium Wild Bar #38
description: Series 4 FM FH Volvo FUPS compliant Wild Bar style custom built Bullbar with 75mm hi-tensile 6mm wall tube with heavy duty uprights, contoured to compliment the new cab shape. Hi-tensile aluminium backing plate, same tensile strength as steel. Flip over "Oversize" sign and driving light mounts to customer spec. LED combination Daylight Running, Indicator lights mounted in uprights.
